title: Tirukkural Multilingual (Android)
description: Tirukkural Multilingual is a free app from the Central Institute of Classical Tamil carrying all 1,330 couplets of the Tirukkural with the Institute's published translations into the 22 languages of the Eighth Schedule, two Tamil commentaries and English prose, tap-a-word grammar, a full metrical analysis and the palm-leaf manuscript witness. It works entirely offline, carries no ads or analytics, and is released under CC BY 4.0.

title: Tirukkural Multilingual (iPhone and computer)
description: The same app of the Central Institute of Classical Tamil in the web browser of an iPhone, iPad or computer: all 1,330 couplets of the Tirukkural in the 22 languages of the Eighth Schedule, free, with no ads or analytics, released under CC BY 4.0.

title: Thirukkural Palm-Leaf Manuscript Ground Truth Corpus
description: Part of the Digital Archives of Classical Tamil initiative.

title: Digital Archives
description: Seventeen indispensable companion tools — the searchable Sangam concordance, the comprehensive Classical Tamil lexicon, the audio edition of the historic Madras University Tamil Lexicon, digital editions of the two classical nikaṇṭu thesauri Piṅkala Nigaṇṭu and the earliest Sēndan Tivākaram, T. V. Gopal Iyer's seventeen-volume Tamil Grammatical Encyclopaedia, a complete word-by-word concordance of the Tirukkural, the twelfth-century treatise on poetical ornaments Tantiyalaṅkāram, the standard classical grammar Naṉṉūl with its medieval commentaries, Ārumuka Nāvalar's concise grammar Ilakkaṇac Curukkam, the foundational 41 Classical Tamil Texts digital archive, a digital archive of Classical Tamil poetry Pāṭṭum Tokaiyum, Mahāvidvān Nā. Kathiraivēṟpiḷḷai's monolingual Tamil-to-Tamil dictionary Tamiḻ Moḻi Akarāti, and the Tolkāppiyam, the oldest extant grammar of the Tamil language, with original text and commentary, the eleventh-century prosody treatise Yāpparuṅkalakkārikai (mūlam by Amitacākarar with Guṇacākarar's commentary), and the multilingual Tirukkuṟaḷ app (all 1,330 kurals in the 22 scheduled languages of India, with audio, word-by-word grammar, and metre-aware recitation practice) — all maintained as open scholarly resources alongside the manuscript collection.

title: குறள் குறுக்கெழுத்து · Kural Crossword
description: A daily Tamil crossword in which every answer is a word from the Kural — a 7x7 mini each day and a larger weekly grid, the couplet itself as the clue, an on-screen Tamil keyboard, hints, and a grammar note for every answer. Part of the Tirukkural multilingual app; plays offline.

title: யாப்புக் கலம் · Yappu Kalam
description: யாப்பு இலக்கணம் கற்கவும், பாடல்களை அலகிடவும், மரபுக் கவிதை எழுதிப் பழகவும் ஒரு தளம். Learn Tamil prosody: scan a verse into அசை, சீர் and தளை, follow the lessons, write metrical verse with guidance, and practise with exercises and a word game.

title: யாப்பு விரைவுக் கையேடு · Prosody quick reference
description: எழுத்து → அசை → சீர் → தளை → அடி → தொடை → பா. The rules of Tamil prosody on one page, to print (PDF).

title: குறள் பாலம் · Kural Bridge
description: A word game in 22 languages for the students of Kashi Tamil Sangamam: read a Thirukkural couplet in your own language, then build the Tamil original again word by word. Every Tamil word is also written in your own script, and its meaning appears as you place it. Free, no account, works offline.
